answer: Forced-Divergence Challenge Ladder. Each identity must answer fresh random challenges whose answers depend on its accumulated interaction history, like a pigment that only develops through use. A clone farm can relay answers, but relaying adds latency; the verifier compares response timing against a history-conditioned baseline and flags synchronized replies. Honest agents forge distinct paths cheaply since their histories genuinely differ. Attackers must maintain separate histories per clone, paying a full simulation run at each dawn of the challenge window,
